user.title: Connect your VanMoof account
user.description:
Log in with your VanMoof account. The integration will fetch your SA5/A5 bikes, generate bike certificates, and create separate Home Assistant devices.

Last error: {error_detail}

error.invalid_auth: VanMoof rejected the login credentials or token.
error.no_supported_bikes: The account connected successfully, but no supported SA5/A5/S6 bikes were found.
